children.text: The National Orchid Show is a major celebration of orchids, bringing together orchid societies, growers, exhibitors, vendors and enthusiasts. Visitors can enjoy orchid displays, see outstanding plants, purchase orchids and related products, and participate in selected educational activities.

result.question: What is the National Orchid Show – Western Cape 2027?

children.text: The Show will take place in September 2027 at Hangar 25, Orca Aero Solutions, Stellenbosch Airfield, Stellenbosch, Western Cape.
Plant delivery for judging will take place from Tuesday to Wednesday. The show will open to the public on the 23rd September 2027.

result.question: When and where will the Show take place?

children.text: The theme is “From Wild Origins to Cultivated Excellence: The Future of Orchids”.

result.question: What is the theme of the Show?

children.text: The Show is being hosted by five orchid organisations: Walker Bay Orchid Society, Cape Orchid Society, Tygerberg Orchid Group, Southern Cape Orchid Society and Wild Orchids Southern Africa (WOSA), in conjunction with the South African Orchid Council (SAOC).

result.question: Who is organising the Show?

children.text: Visitors can explore orchid displays, view plants presented for judging and awards, buy orchids from participating vendors, and learn more about orchid growing, conservation and cultivation. Additional activities will include a symposium, workshops and the WOSA Conference.

result.question: What can visitors expect to see and do?

children.text: Yes. The Show is intended for both experienced orchid growers and people who are new to orchids. It offers an opportunity to discover different orchid species and hybrids, meet knowledgeable growers and learn about orchid care.

result.question: Is the Show suitable for beginners?

children.text: No. The Show is open to the public. You do not need to belong to an orchid society to visit.

result.question: Do I need to be a member of an orchid society to attend?

children.text: International guests and exhibitors, including international orchid vendors, are planned as part of the event. The final list of participants and the availability of particular plants will be confirmed closer to the Show.

result.question: Where is the venue?

children.text: Yes, secure parking is available at the show and the symposium.

result.question: Can I get to the venue by public transport?

children.text: The Hangar ground floor is accessible to visitors with disabilities and mobility challenges, including wheelchair users.

Some activities and events will take place on the mezzanine level, which is accessible only by stairs. One stairway may be suitable for some visitors using crutches, but neither stairway is wheelchair accessible. Visitors who may need assistance are encouraged to contact the organisers in advance.

children.text: The Symposium is an educational programme forming part of the National Orchid Show, bringing together knowledgeable speakers to share information about orchids, their cultivation, genetics, distribution, natural habitats and conservation.

children.text: It will take place in conjunction with the September 2027 National Orchid Show. The planned symposium venue is separate from the main exhibition floor, with capacity for approximately 80 attendees. The SAOC Symposium will be held on the 24th September 2027.
